title: Warm beetroot apple salad
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Warm beetroot apple salad. Ingredient reference: Beetroot, Apple, Greek yogurt, Lemon, Water. Preparation reference: One batch makes 3 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 45 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 0 minutes. Scrub the beetroot and place whole in a saucepan with the water. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 40 to 45 minutes until a knife enters easily. Drain and leave until cool enough to handle, then rub off the skins and cut into wedges. Wash, core and thinly slice the apple. Juice the lemon and mix it with the Greek yogurt. Gently toss the still-warm beetroot and apple with the dressing. Divide among three plates and serve warm, without reheating the yogurt..
